description: This Java class defines a command for deleting a PolicyEntry within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization and resource path generation.

classes.name: DeletePolicyEntry
classes.description: A command class for deleting a specific PolicyEntry identified by policy ID and label, with JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DeletePolicyEntry instance from PolicyId, Label, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeletePolicyEntry instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the PolicyEntry to delete.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this delete command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource being deleted.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command payload to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of DeletePolicyEntry.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
